I'm a one-man photography business.

I run 17 AI bots.

My whole AI setup costs about $200/month, less than one portrait session.

Here's my exact setup (steal it):

1. One boss bot. I only talk to my chief of staff. It hands every job to the right bot.

2. Money bots. One books clients, one pitches galleries, one runs my Etsy shop, one scores new income ideas.

3. Marketing bots. Research, outreach, SEO, and one that makes AI drafts sound like me.

4. Back office. A bookkeeper and a fact-checker.

This week alone they:
- Fixed a slow Etsy listing (title, tags, price)
- Rescued 5 failed YouTube Shorts
- Wrote and voiced 2 full YouTube videos
- Answered a gallery inquiry

The one rule that makes it work: nothing gets sent, posted, bought or deleted without my OK.

I've saved so many hours I'm almost bored.

Built on Grok Bot. Bookmark this for later.

items.author: TimothyBrown
items.text:
Set up something fun this week: my AI assistant Misato (Grok Bot) can now use my Mac mini's Mail, Messages, Calendar, Contacts and Maps remotely. All read-only, all through MCP.

The core is iMCP, a macOS app that exposes Apple's apps as MCP tools. Its imcp-server speaks stdio, which is great locally, but my assistant lives in the cloud, so I needed a real HTTP endpoint. Here's the chain:

Grok Bot connector (HTTPS + Bearer token)
-> Tailscale Funnel (public HTTPS on my tailnet)
-> Caddy on 127.0.0.1:8001, checks the token
-> supergateway on :8000 (stdio to streamable HTTP)
-> imcp-server -> Mail, Messages, Calendar, Contacts, Maps

Caddy is the bouncer. Without a valid Bearer token you get a 401, both locally and over the Funnel. With one, MCP initialize comes back clean and Misato sees the tools. My work calendar stays on my iPhone, which she reads separately, and she flags conflicts between the two in my morning rundown.

Next up are launchd persistence and locking the bridge to localhost. If you've got a Mac sitting around, iMCP + supergateway + Caddy + Tailscale Funnel turns out to be a surprisingly small amount of glue!

items.author: MartinBarna333
items.text:
Grok Bot tip: don't give recurring routines to your main bot :)
I set up one bot just for routines. It runs in a short clean chat, so the main chat doesn't burn tokens.
Routines max 1 to 2x a day, better on an event (an email arrives) than on a timer.
The know-how lives in files, not in the bot's head. When I swap it, the new one keeps going right away.
Works like a charm! :)

en.summary: The author set up one bot just for routines; it runs in a short clean chat, so the main chat doesn’t burn tokens. Routines run at most 1 to 2 times a day, preferably on an event such as an incoming email rather than a timer. Know-how lives in files, not in the bot, so a replacement bot picks up right away.

ja.summary: 作者が作ったGrok Botは、ブランド名と国を渡すと現在配信中の広告を集め、スライド資料と広告1件1行のシートを返す。作者が最初に見るのは各広告の配信期間の列。

ko.title: 공개 광고 라이브러리를 대신 읽어 주는 Grok Bot
ko.summary: 작성자가 만든 Grok Bot은 브랜드와 국가를 주면 해당 브랜드의 집행 중인 광고를 모아 발표 자료와 광고당 한 행짜리 시트를 돌려준다. 작성자가 가장 먼저 보는 열은 광고별 집행 기간이다.

ms.title: Grok Bot yang membaca perpustakaan iklan awam untuk anda
ms.summary: Penulis membina Grok Bot: beri jenama dan negara, ia menarik iklan aktif jenama itu dan memulangkan dek serta helaian dengan satu baris bagi setiap iklan. Lajur pertama yang penulis semak ialah berapa lama setiap iklan telah berjalan.

vi.title: Grok Bot đọc thư viện quảng cáo công khai giúp bạn
vi.summary: Tác giả dựng một Grok Bot: đưa tên thương hiệu và quốc gia, nó lấy các quảng cáo đang chạy của thương hiệu đó và trả về một bộ slide cùng một bảng tính, mỗi quảng cáo một dòng. Cột tác giả xem đầu tiên là mỗi quảng cáo đã chạy bao lâu.

fr.title: Un Grok Bot qui lit les bibliothèques publicitaires publiques
fr.summary: L’auteur a créé un Grok Bot : donnez-lui une marque et un pays, il récupère les publicités actives de la marque et rend un deck et un tableur, une ligne par pub. La première colonne que l’auteur regarde : depuis combien de temps chaque pub tourne.

es.title: Un Grok Bot que lee bibliotecas públicas de anuncios
es.summary: El autor creó un Grok Bot: le das una marca y un país, extrae sus anuncios activos y devuelve una presentación y una hoja con una fila por anuncio. La primera columna que mira el autor es cuánto tiempo lleva activo cada anuncio.

de.title: Ein Grok Bot, der öffentliche Werbebibliotheken auswertet
de.summary: Der Autor hat einen Grok Bot gebaut: Man gibt eine Marke und ein Land an, er holt die laufenden Anzeigen der Marke und liefert ein Deck plus eine Tabelle mit einer Zeile pro Anzeige. Die erste Spalte, die der Autor prüft: wie lange jede Anzeige schon läuft.

zh-TW.title: 用 skill 保存重複任務，再用 routine 排程
zh-TW.summary: 作者說明 Grok Bot 可以把可重複的工作存成 skill，再用 routine 加上時間表，並以一份 AI 工具簡報做了測試。貼文附有提示詞、指南和完整影片連結。

en.title: Save a repeatable job as a skill, then schedule it with a routine
en.summary: The author explains that Grok Bot can save a repeatable job as a skill, and a routine adds the schedule; they tested it on an AI-tools brief. The post links the prompts, a guide and the full video.

ja.title: 繰り返し作業をskillに保存し、routineで定期実行
ja.summary: Grok Botは繰り返し作業をskillとして保存でき、routineでスケジュールを付けられると作者が解説。AIツールのブリーフで試した。投稿にはプロンプト、ガイド、フル動画のリンクがある。

ko.title: 반복 작업은 skill로 저장하고 routine으로 예약
ko.summary: 작성자는 Grok Bot이 반복 작업을 skill로 저장하고 routine으로 일정을 붙일 수 있다고 설명하며, AI 도구 브리핑으로 테스트했다. 게시물에 프롬프트, 가이드, 전체 영상 링크가 있다.

ms.title: Simpan kerja berulang sebagai skill, kemudian jadualkan dengan routine
ms.summary: Penulis menerangkan Grok Bot boleh menyimpan kerja berulang sebagai skill, dan routine menambah jadual; mereka mengujinya pada taklimat alat AI. Hantaran memautkan prompt, panduan dan video penuh.

vi.title: Lưu việc lặp lại thành skill, rồi hẹn lịch bằng routine
vi.summary: Tác giả giải thích Grok Bot có thể lưu một việc lặp lại thành skill, còn routine thêm lịch chạy; họ thử với một bản tin về công cụ AI. Bài đăng có link prompt, hướng dẫn và video đầy đủ.

fr.title: Enregistrer une tâche répétitive en skill, puis la planifier avec une routine
fr.summary: L’auteur explique que Grok Bot peut enregistrer une tâche répétitive comme skill, et qu’une routine y ajoute le planning ; testé sur un brief d’outils IA. Le post renvoie aux prompts, à un guide et à la vidéo complète.

es.title: Guarda una tarea repetible como skill y prográmala con una routine
es.summary: El autor explica que Grok Bot puede guardar una tarea repetible como skill y una routine le añade el horario; lo probaron con un informe de herramientas de IA. El post enlaza los prompts, una guía y el vídeo completo.

de.title: Wiederkehrende Aufgabe als Skill speichern und per Routine planen
de.summary: Der Autor erklärt, dass Grok Bot eine wiederholbare Aufgabe als Skill speichern kann und eine Routine den Zeitplan ergänzt; getestet an einem KI-Tools-Briefing. Der Post verlinkt Prompts, Anleitung und das ganze Video.

I gave Grok Bot its own email address, then built a private mail app on top of it 📬

There's no inbox API, so I didn't fake one. An hourly routine syncs mail into Neon, and nothing goes out until I press Send.

How I built Grok Mail:
https://t.co/nPgWk3qa9d

zh-CN.title: 给 Grok Bot 一个邮箱，再做一个私人邮件应用
zh-CN.summary: 作者给 Grok Bot 配了独立邮箱地址，并在此之上做了私人邮件应用 Grok Mail。由于没有收件箱 API，他没有伪造接口，而是用每小时一次的 routine 把邮件同步进 Neon 数据库；任何邮件都要他按下发送才会发出。

zh-TW.title: 給 Grok Bot 一個信箱，再做一個私人郵件應用
zh-TW.summary: 作者給 Grok Bot 配了獨立信箱地址，並在此之上做了私人郵件應用 Grok Mail。由於沒有收件匣 API，他沒有偽造介面，而是用每小時一次的 routine 把郵件同步進 Neon 資料庫；任何郵件都要他按下傳送才會發出。

en.title: Giving Grok Bot an email address and building a private mail app on it
en.summary: The author gave Grok Bot its own email address and built a private mail app, Grok Mail, on top. With no inbox API, they didn’t fake one: an hourly routine syncs mail into a Neon database, and nothing goes out until they press Send.

ja.title: Grok Botにメールアドレスを持たせ、私用メールアプリを構築
ja.summary: 作者はGrok Botに専用メールアドレスを与え、その上に私用メールアプリ「Grok Mail」を作った。受信箱APIがないので偽装はせず、1時間ごとのroutineでメールをNeonデータベースに同期。送信ボタンを押すまで何も送られない。

ko.title: Grok Bot에 이메일 주소를 주고 개인 메일 앱을 만들다
ko.summary: 작성자는 Grok Bot에 전용 이메일 주소를 주고 그 위에 개인 메일 앱 Grok Mail을 만들었다. 받은편지함 API가 없어 흉내 내지 않고, 매시간 routine으로 메일을 Neon 데이터베이스에 동기화한다. 직접 보내기를 누르기 전엔 아무것도 발송되지 않는다.

ms.title: Memberi Grok Bot alamat e-mel dan membina aplikasi mel peribadi
ms.summary: Penulis memberi Grok Bot alamat e-mel sendiri dan membina aplikasi mel peribadi, Grok Mail, di atasnya. Tiada API peti masuk, jadi mereka tidak memalsukannya: routine setiap jam menyegerakkan mel ke pangkalan data Neon, dan tiada apa dihantar sehingga mereka menekan Hantar.

vi.title: Cấp cho Grok Bot một địa chỉ email và dựng ứng dụng mail riêng
vi.summary: Tác giả cấp cho Grok Bot địa chỉ email riêng rồi dựng ứng dụng mail cá nhân Grok Mail trên đó. Không có API hộp thư nên họ không giả lập: một routine mỗi giờ đồng bộ thư vào cơ sở dữ liệu Neon, và không thư nào gửi đi cho đến khi họ bấm Gửi.

fr.title: Une adresse e-mail pour Grok Bot et une appli mail privée par-dessus
fr.summary: L’auteur a donné à Grok Bot sa propre adresse e-mail et construit dessus une appli mail privée, Grok Mail. Faute d’API de boîte de réception, pas de bricolage : une routine horaire synchronise le courrier dans une base Neon, et rien ne part avant qu’il clique sur Envoyer.

es.title: Un correo propio para Grok Bot y una app de correo privada encima
es.summary: El autor le dio a Grok Bot su propia dirección de correo y construyó encima una app privada, Grok Mail. Sin API de bandeja de entrada, no la simuló: una routine cada hora sincroniza el correo en una base Neon, y nada sale hasta que pulsa Enviar.

de.title: Eine E-Mail-Adresse für Grok Bot und eine private Mail-App darauf
de.summary: Der Autor gab Grok Bot eine eigene E-Mail-Adresse und baute darauf die private Mail-App Grok Mail. Ohne Postfach-API wird nichts vorgetäuscht: Eine stündliche Routine synchronisiert die Mails in eine Neon-Datenbank, und nichts geht raus, bevor er auf Senden drückt.

SpaceXSI sales now runs on shared Grok Bots:

- Account Intel Bot updates Salesforce after calls
- Quote Bot builds quotes and order forms
- Deal Bot reviews non-standard terms

Reps can't use Quote Bot to approve their own discounts. Guardrails by design.
https://t.co/KmDfpOKzgp

zh-CN.title: 销售团队用共享 Grok Bot 分工
zh-CN.summary: 帖子称 SpaceXSI 的销售由共享 Grok Bot 支撑：客户情报 Bot 通话后更新 Salesforce，报价 Bot 生成报价单和订单表，交易 Bot 审核非标准条款。销售不能用报价 Bot 批准自己的折扣，这是有意设计的护栏。

zh-TW.title: 銷售團隊用共享 Grok Bot 分工
zh-TW.summary: 貼文稱 SpaceXSI 的銷售由共享 Grok Bot 支撐：客戶情報 Bot 通話後更新 Salesforce，報價 Bot 產生報價單和訂單表，交易 Bot 審核非標準條款。業務不能用報價 Bot 核准自己的折扣，這是刻意設計的護欄。

en.title: A sales team split across shared Grok Bots
en.summary: The post says SpaceXSI sales runs on shared Grok Bots: an Account Intel Bot updates Salesforce after calls, a Quote Bot builds quotes and order forms, and a Deal Bot reviews non-standard terms. Reps can’t use the Quote Bot to approve their own discounts, a guardrail by design.

ja.title: 営業チームが共有Grok Botで分業
ja.summary: 投稿によるとSpaceXSIの営業は共有Grok Botで回っている。顧客情報Botが通話後にSalesforceを更新し、見積Botが見積書と注文書を作り、取引Botが標準外の条件を確認する。営業担当は見積Botで自分の値引きを承認できない設計になっている。

ko.title: 영업팀이 공유 Grok Bot으로 분업
ko.summary: 게시물에 따르면 SpaceXSI 영업은 공유 Grok Bot으로 돌아간다. 고객 인텔 봇은 통화 후 Salesforce를 갱신하고, 견적 봇은 견적서와 주문서를 만들며, 딜 봇은 비표준 조건을 검토한다. 영업 담당자는 견적 봇으로 자기 할인을 승인할 수 없도록 설계됐다.

ms.title: Pasukan jualan dibahagikan antara Grok Bot dikongsi
ms.summary: Hantaran menyatakan jualan SpaceXSI berjalan pada Grok Bot dikongsi: Account Intel Bot mengemas kini Salesforce selepas panggilan, Quote Bot membina sebut harga dan borang pesanan, dan Deal Bot menyemak terma bukan standard. Wakil jualan tidak boleh guna Quote Bot untuk meluluskan diskaun sendiri, satu kawalan yang disengajakan.

vi.title: Đội bán hàng chia việc qua các Grok Bot dùng chung
vi.summary: Bài đăng cho biết bộ phận bán hàng SpaceXSI chạy trên các Grok Bot dùng chung: Account Intel Bot cập nhật Salesforce sau cuộc gọi, Quote Bot lập báo giá và đơn đặt hàng, Deal Bot rà soát điều khoản không chuẩn. Nhân viên không thể dùng Quote Bot để tự duyệt chiết khấu của mình, đây là rào chắn có chủ đích.

fr.title: Une équipe commerciale répartie sur des Grok Bots partagés
fr.summary: Selon le post, les ventes de SpaceXSI tournent sur des Grok Bots partagés : un Account Intel Bot met à jour Salesforce après les appels, un Quote Bot prépare devis et bons de commande, un Deal Bot examine les clauses non standard. Les commerciaux ne peuvent pas approuver leurs propres remises via le Quote Bot, un garde-fou voulu.

es.title: Un equipo de ventas repartido en Grok Bots compartidos
es.summary: Según el post, las ventas de SpaceXSI funcionan con Grok Bots compartidos: un Account Intel Bot actualiza Salesforce tras las llamadas, un Quote Bot prepara presupuestos y pedidos y un Deal Bot revisa condiciones no estándar. Los comerciales no pueden aprobar sus propios descuentos con el Quote Bot, una barrera intencionada.

de.title: Ein Vertriebsteam auf geteilten Grok Bots
de.summary: Laut Post läuft der Vertrieb von SpaceXSI auf geteilten Grok Bots: Ein Account-Intel-Bot aktualisiert Salesforce nach Calls, ein Quote-Bot erstellt Angebote und Bestellformulare, ein Deal-Bot prüft Sonderkonditionen. Vertriebler können ihre eigenen Rabatte nicht über den Quote-Bot freigeben, eine bewusste Leitplanke.

zh-CN.title: 7 个 Bot 只有 1 个定时，每周约 60 次运行
zh-CN.summary: 作者称很多人的 Grok Bot routine 每周白跑 1,176 次，而他 7 个 Bot 做同样的事每周只跑约 60 次，只有 1 个按时间表运行：Scout 每周一 9:00 扫描 X 上人们抱怨什么，其余 Bot（如 Pain Miner、Judge）接力处理。帖子正文在此处被截断。

zh-TW.title: 7 個 Bot 只有 1 個排程，每週約 60 次執行
zh-TW.summary: 作者稱很多人的 Grok Bot routine 每週白跑 1,176 次，而他 7 個 Bot 做同樣的事每週只跑約 60 次，只有 1 個按時間表執行：Scout 每週一 9:00 掃描 X 上大家抱怨什麼，其餘 Bot（如 Pain Miner、Judge）接力處理。貼文正文在此處被截斷。

en.title: Seven bots, only one on a schedule, about 60 runs a week
en.summary: The author says many people’s Grok Bot routines run 1,176 times a week for nothing, while his 7 bots do the same work in about 60 runs, with only one on a timer: Scout scans X every Monday at 09:00 for what people complain about, and others such as Pain Miner and Judge take it from there. The post text is cut off at that point.

ja.title: 7体中タイマー起動は1体だけ、週約60回の実行
ja.summary: 作者によると多くの人のGrok Botのroutineは週1,176回も無駄に動いているが、自分の7体は同じ仕事を週約60回で済ませ、タイマーで動くのは1体だけ。Scoutが毎週月曜9:00にXで人々の不満を探し、Pain MinerやJudgeなどが引き継ぐ。投稿本文はそこで途切れている。

ko.title: 봇 7개 중 예약 실행은 1개, 주 약 60회 실행
ko.summary: 작성자는 많은 사람의 Grok Bot routine이 주 1,176번 헛돌지만, 자신의 봇 7개는 같은 일을 주 약 60회로 처리하며 타이머로 도는 건 하나뿐이라고 한다. Scout가 매주 월요일 09:00 X에서 사람들의 불만을 찾고, Pain Miner와 Judge 등이 이어받는다. 게시물 본문은 그 지점에서 잘려 있다.

ms.title: Tujuh bot, hanya satu berjadual, kira-kira 60 larian seminggu
ms.summary: Penulis berkata rutin Grok Bot ramai orang berjalan 1,176 kali seminggu tanpa hasil, manakala 7 botnya membuat kerja sama dalam kira-kira 60 larian, hanya satu pada pemasa: Scout mengimbas X setiap Isnin 09:00 untuk aduan orang, dan bot lain seperti Pain Miner dan Judge menyambung. Teks hantaran terpotong di situ.

vi.title: Bảy bot, chỉ một bot chạy theo lịch, khoảng 60 lượt mỗi tuần
vi.summary: Tác giả nói routine Grok Bot của nhiều người chạy 1.176 lần mỗi tuần vô ích, còn 7 bot của anh làm cùng việc với khoảng 60 lượt, chỉ một bot hẹn giờ: Scout quét X mỗi thứ Hai 09:00 xem mọi người phàn nàn gì, các bot khác như Pain Miner và Judge làm tiếp. Nội dung bài bị cắt ở đoạn này.

fr.title: Sept bots, un seul planifié, environ 60 exécutions par semaine
fr.summary: L’auteur affirme que les routines Grok Bot de beaucoup tournent 1 176 fois par semaine pour rien, alors que ses 7 bots font le même travail en environ 60 exécutions, un seul sur minuteur : Scout analyse X chaque lundi à 9 h pour repérer les plaintes, puis d’autres comme Pain Miner et Judge prennent le relais. Le texte du post est coupé ensuite.

es.title: Siete bots, solo uno programado, unas 60 ejecuciones por semana
es.summary: El autor dice que las routines de Grok Bot de mucha gente corren 1.176 veces por semana para nada, mientras sus 7 bots hacen lo mismo en unas 60, con solo uno por temporizador: Scout revisa X cada lunes a las 09:00 en busca de quejas y otros como Pain Miner y Judge siguen. El texto del post se corta ahí.

de.title: Sieben Bots, nur einer per Zeitplan, rund 60 Läufe pro Woche
de.summary: Der Autor sagt, die Grok-Bot-Routinen vieler laufen 1.176 Mal pro Woche umsonst, während seine 7 Bots dieselbe Arbeit mit etwa 60 Läufen erledigen, nur einer per Timer: Scout durchsucht X jeden Montag um 09:00 nach Beschwerden, andere wie Pain Miner und Judge übernehmen. Der Posttext bricht an dieser Stelle ab.

ja.title: Meta Muse内の仮想PCでPythonを動かし長尺動画を作る
ja.summary: Meta Museの動画生成は1回10秒まで。作者はMuseのクラウド上の仮想PCでPythonを動かし、複数の動画をつなげて長尺動画にしている。プロンプトだけで可能で、先に台本を作る。投稿の動画もこの方法で作られ、手順へのリンクがある。

items.author: astralwave
items.text:
Oh yes, I know! I tried to use Dots to steer Codex and it was a nightmare. 

I ended up having to setup a custom tunnel MCP so my Dot can tunnel into my Mac and drive agents via the Paseo MCP. It works better than its native Codex orchestration, but still wasn’t great (it doesn’t know how to prompt agents! It talks to external agents like its own internal thinking trace and as if those agents share its context window), so I stopped doing that.

Grok Bot is better but it eats tokens like crazy. Still figuring out my setup there but it at least reliably reacts to a Tibo reset and then burns it down to 0 as quickly as possible before the next reset. 

The best coordinator setup I found so far is Claude Projects. Lot of rough edges now since it’s beta (especially around permissions), but I feel the most productive in it. 

Especially when you lean into using Artifacts to review work and make decisions.

I mostly felt that way too, but over the last couple of days something that helped me a lot is trying to think "how do I manage an employee" when thinking about Dot. When I was a manager it would never have worked if I just tried to track everything in a single DM inbox with each of my engineers, so I just shouldn't try to do the same thing with Dot.
If Dot was another person that I was working with on a bunch of things, I'd try to use tools like task managers (e.g. todoist) and knowledge bases (e.g. notion) to keep track of what they're up to, what they did, what they delivered, what's still open, what needs my attention, etc. We'd dm each other when we need to, but we wouldn't try to make this the only way we'd organise stuff. 
So I've started doing the same thing with Elminster (my Dot), and so far it seems to work pretty well. We have a notion workspace where Elminster documents where things are on different projects, their next steps, blockers, decisions needed from me, etc. As unfathomably corporate brain as it sounds I have daily 1:1s with him to get an overview of where things stand and what's next.
It's VERY far from perfect, but it works *much* better than it did when I just tried to talk to him to the Dots single chat. Really recommend people to try this reframe and see what you think.

He says it’s far from perfect but works much better than chat alone.

ja.summary: Dotsの単一チャットだけで管理するのはうまくいかなかったため、作者は自分のDot「Elminster」を部下のエンジニアのように扱う。Notionのワークスペースに各プロジェクトの状況、次の手順、障害、判断が必要な事項を記録させ、毎日1対1で状況を確認する。完璧には程遠いが、チャットだけよりずっと良いという。

ko.title: Dot을 직원처럼 관리하기
ko.summary: Dots 단일 채팅에서 모든 걸 관리하니 잘 안 돼서, 작성자는 자기 Dot인 Elminster를 관리하는 엔지니어처럼 대한다. Notion 워크스페이스에 프로젝트 현황, 다음 단계, 장애 요소, 결정이 필요한 사항을 기록하게 하고 매일 1:1을 한다. 완벽과는 거리가 멀지만 채팅만 할 때보다 훨씬 낫다고 한다.

ms.title: Urus Dot anda seperti pekerja
ms.summary: Menjejak segalanya dalam satu sembang Dots tidak berkesan, jadi penulis melayan Dot-nya, Elminster, seperti jurutera yang diurusnya: Elminster mendokumenkan status projek, langkah seterusnya, halangan dan keputusan yang perlu dalam ruang kerja Notion, dan mereka mengadakan 1:1 harian. Katanya jauh dari sempurna tetapi jauh lebih baik daripada sembang sahaja.

vi.title: Quản lý Dot như quản lý nhân viên
vi.summary: Theo dõi mọi thứ trong một cuộc chat Dots duy nhất không hiệu quả, nên tác giả đối xử với Dot của mình, Elminster, như một kỹ sư anh quản lý: Elminster ghi lại tiến độ dự án, bước tiếp theo, vướng mắc và các quyết định cần anh trong một workspace Notion, và họ họp 1:1 hằng ngày. Anh nói còn xa mới hoàn hảo nhưng tốt hơn nhiều so với chỉ chat.

fr.title: Gérer son Dot comme un employé
fr.summary: Tout suivre dans l’unique chat Dots ne marchait pas, alors l’auteur traite son Dot, Elminster, comme un ingénieur qu’il manage : Elminster documente dans un espace Notion l’état des projets, les prochaines étapes, les blocages et les décisions attendues, et ils font un 1:1 quotidien. Loin d’être parfait, dit-il, mais bien mieux que le seul chat.

es.title: Gestiona tu Dot como a un empleado
es.summary: Llevarlo todo en el único chat de Dots no funcionaba, así que el autor trata a su Dot, Elminster, como a un ingeniero a su cargo: Elminster documenta en un espacio de Notion el estado de los proyectos, próximos pasos, bloqueos y decisiones pendientes, y tienen un 1:1 diario. Dice que está lejos de ser perfecto, pero va mucho mejor que solo chatear.

de.title: Den eigenen Dot wie einen Mitarbeiter führen
de.summary: Alles im einen Dots-Chat zu verfolgen klappte nicht, also behandelt der Autor seinen Dot Elminster wie einen Engineer, den er führt: Elminster dokumentiert in einem Notion-Workspace Projektstand, nächste Schritte, Blocker und nötige Entscheidungen, und sie halten tägliche 1:1s. Weit von perfekt, sagt er, aber viel besser als reiner Chat.
